column2: [intro]
I open my fridge, full of colorful greens
Zucchini, spinach, we'll feast like kings and queens!
I chop the onions, tomatoes in a dice
In my kitchen, fun and flavor will suffice!
I love to cook lasagna with a crispy crust
Without meat, it's my secret, it's a must!
Veggies and cheese, a dish so bright
My veggie lasagna, I'll eat every bite!
I simmer my veggies in a pan with care
With herbs and garlic, it's a flavorful affair!
I prepare my béchamel, smooth and creamy
My plate will be full, an explosion of harmony!
I love to cook lasagna with a crispy crust
Without meat, it's my secret, it's a must!
Veggies and cheese, a dish so bright
My veggie lasagna, I'll eat every bite!
[ solo ]
So if you want to feast without the meat
Veggie lasagna is a treat so neat!
Come to my kitchen, let's have a ball
We'll feast together, one and all!
[outro]
